title: BioKG-Align v0.2.0 Submission Schema
description: JSON-Schema description of the participant submission TSV for the BioKG-Align main track (block-scoring format). The submission is a tab-separated values file; this schema documents the per-row structure and the file-level invariants. Validation tooling: the kit's `biokg-align-kit verify` enforces these rules.

format.description: Format identifier. Not a column in the TSV; included here for tooling that wants to embed the schema reference.

file_layout.description: Per-row structure of the submission TSV.

SrcEntity.description: Source entity identifier from the released graph (e.g. 'SNOMED:12345').

TgtEntity.description: Target entity identifier; must be a member of that query's candidate set (see block-layout).

Relation.description: Relation type. Must be one of the canonical paper §1.4 values unless the build overrides `submission.relations`.

block_layout.description: Positional grouping of submission rows into per-query blocks. The canonical query order is determined by the concatenation of `tasks/<task>/test.cands.tsv` files in canonical task order.

canonical_task_order.description: Order in which per-task cands.tsv files are conceptually concatenated to define the global query order.

block_size.description: Number of submission rows per query. Computed as `candidate_count * |submission.relations|`. Canonical: 50 * 3 = 150.

candidate_count.description: Number of candidate target entities per query.

relations_per_query.description: Number of relations scored per (query, candidate) pair.

positional_invariant.const: row[i] belongs to block[i // block_size]; block[k] corresponds to test.cands.tsv row k
positional_invariant.description: How the scorer maps submission rows back to queries.

intra_block_order.const: free; the scorer indexes by (TgtEntity, Relation) within each block
intra_block_order.description: The 150 rows within a single block can appear in any order. The scorer indexes by (TgtEntity, Relation); ordering does not affect the metric.

validation_rules.description: Strictness rules applied by the platform scorer (`load_block_format_predictions`) and by the kit's local validator (`validate_submission`). See `documentation/block_scoring.md (Strictness rules)`.

const: Block contains rows for a SrcEntity disagreeing with cands.tsv
Score not parseable as a finite float (NaN and infinity are rejected)
Duplicate (TgtEntity, Relation) pair within a block (platform keeps max score)
Missing canonical (TgtEntity, Relation) pair within a block (platform assigns score -inf, i.e. last-rank)
Row's TgtEntity not in that query's candidate set

sizing.description: Expected file sizes for the canonical build.

n_queries_canonical.description: Total test queries across all three tasks under the canonical pool model at fraction=1.0.

n_rows_canonical.description: Total submission rows for the canonical build (n_queries_canonical * block_size = 30,216 * 150).
